We registered for the service on December 28, 2020, but when we had an appointment on January 11, 2021, they told us we hadn't registered. What's going on?
My boyfriend and I signed and approved the registration.
Then the assistant said they couldn't find the form and told us we hadn't registered. What?! You made a mistake, it's your fault, but you didn't say anything. The patient lost their rights, and you just told the patient we hadn't registered. This is terrible...
